note: Merchant DATA read by the generic merchant-fit engine (src/sourcing/core/field/merchant-fit.js). Nothing here is code. Lists are built from the HABB description (personalised gifts + UV printing, shop in Namur + habb.be) and from general UV-printing practice; the owner must confirm or change every value. A value left null is NOT a default: the matching dimension stays UNKNOWN/PARTIAL and says what the owner still has to set.

uvPrint.basis: general UV flatbed practice (rigid, smooth surfaces print well; soft, porous or textile surfaces need another process). To be confirmed by HABB production.

difficultMaterials.why: soft, low-energy surface: needs a primer or another process
textile: UV flatbed is not the process
textile: UV flatbed is not the process
textile or flexible: UV flatbed is not the process

retailPrice.note: owner to set { min, max } (VAT included) for the price range HABB sells in

margin.note: the margin target is entered per case (sale.targetContributionPct); this is only a floor if the owner wants one for every case

storage.note: owner to set: the largest unit volume HABB is willing to stock

shipping.note: owner to set the heaviest unit that is still practical to post

novelty.note: needs market observations (Amazon listings, searches). Without them: UNKNOWN

assortment.note: owner to confirm the categories HABB already sells

negotiation.note: the opening target is this percentage below the maximum purchase price (editable). It is an arithmetic step, not a forecast of what a supplier will accept.
